name_reason: Follows fd2_dpmi_* convention with a clear descriptor (alloc_dos_memory) that accurately reflects the body: DPMI INT 31h fn 0x100 'Allocate DOS Memory Block'. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Allocate a DOS conventional-memory block via DPMI INT 31h function 0x100, return its linear address / real-mode segment / PM selector, and lock the allocated pages in physical memory.
logic_summary: Zero-fills the input REGS struct, sets EAX=0x100 (DPMI fn) and EBX=paragraph_count, then int386(0x31). On success (carry flag clear): writes *out_segment = AX<<16 (real-mode segment in the high word), *out_linear = (AX&0xFFFF)<<4 (linear address = segment*16), *out_selector = DX&0xFFFF (PM selector handle). Then calls fd2_dpmi_lock_region(linear>>12, (paragraphs*16 + linear>>12) - 1) to lock the page range covering the block. Returns (cflag == 0) as a bool success flag.
signature: int fd2_dpmi_alloc_dos_memory(uint32 paragraphs, uint32 *out_linear, uint32 *out_segment, uint32 *out_selector)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Requested allocation size in paragraphs (16-byte units). Loaded into EBX for DPMI fn 0x100 and reused to compute the lock page-range end. Caller (AIL_internal_install_driver_inner) passes (image_size + 0xf) >> 4, i.e. byte size rounded up to paragraphs.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Out pointer: receives the linear address of the block (= real-mode segment * 16, AX&0xFFFF<<4). Caller stores it at ptr[2] and later uses it directly as the memmove destination for the driver image.
params.reason: Generic placeholder param_2; it is an output pointer for the linear address. Source home file already uses 'out_linear'.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Out pointer: receives the real-mode segment word for DOS in the high 16 bits (AX<<16). Caller stores it at ptr[0]; later passed back to fd2_dpmi_free_dos_memory as the segment_unused arg.
params.reason: Generic placeholder param_3; it is an output pointer for the real-mode segment. Source home file already uses 'out_segment'.

params.name: param_4
params.semantics: Out pointer: receives the protected-mode selector handle (DX&0xFFFF) returned by DPMI fn 0x100. Caller stores it at ptr[1]; later passed to fd2_dpmi_free_dos_memory as the selector to free the block.
params.reason: Generic placeholder param_4; it is an output pointer for the PM selector handle. Source home file already uses 'out_selector'.

returns.semantics: Boolean success flag: 1 when the DPMI host cleared the carry flag (allocation succeeded), 0 on failure (CF set). On failure no outputs are written and no region is locked.
